title: Rolling 3-month average transaction volume per account, 2025
prompt: For each account, show its 3-month rolling average transaction volume for each month of 2025.
population: Transactions from Nov 2024 through 2025 (two prior months are needed to seed the first 2025 rolling averages), aggregated to account × month.
grain: One row per account per month (2025 months in the final output).
metricDefinition: 3-month rolling average of monthly transaction volume, per account, for 2025.
referenceSql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT account_id, date_trunc('month', occurred_at) AS month, sum(amount) AS month_total FROM transactions WHERE occurred_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-11-01' AND occurred_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY account_id, date_trunc('month', occurred_at)) SELECT account_id, month, month_total, avg(month_total) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3mo_avg FROM monthly WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01' ORDER BY account_id, month
